title: defaultCheckReadGrant enforces grant-row dual-control (canonical parity)
root_cause: defaultCheckReadGrant (src/http/report-page-render.ts) — the application-level read gate behind GET /api/report-pages/:id/render|data — queried application/read grants with a bespoke inline SQL query that checked NEITHER the grant row's own confirmed_by NOR the T-0397 dual-control (confirmed2_by via criticalGrantPredicate). The canonical resolver getGrantsForSubject (src/db/grants-dao.ts step 3) DOES enforce both. So an UNCONFIRMED application/read grant, or a CRITICAL read grant (carrying a sensitive/garbage clearance marker) confirmed by only ONE approver, PASSED the application-level gate the single authority path would reject. Dual-control was bypassable on the application-level read path (asymmetry found on T-0632).
fix_approach: apply-predicate (via reuse of the EXPORTED canonical classifier — NOT a re-implementation)
fix_detail: Exported criticalGrantPredicate from grants-dao.ts (single source of truth for the T-0397 criticality axes) and reused it verbatim in defaultCheckReadGrant's grant query as `AND (NOT ${criticalGrantPredicate("g")} OR g.confirmed2_by IS NOT NULL)`. Also added `AND g.confirmed_by IS NOT NULL` (base confirmation) and aligned the assignment-active predicate to the canonical T-0605 form `AND (ra.confirmed2_by IS NOT NULL OR ra.proposed_by IS NULL)`. Did NOT fully route through getGrantsForSubject because actor-authority-deactivation-gate.sh registers defaultCheckReadGrant as authority resolver C and FF-0662-1 requires it to carry its own ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL marker on an actor slug-lookup; full delegation (0 lookups, 0 marker) would have forced editing that frozen security-gate registry (reclassification = founder-class, out of a coder's lane). The inline actor lookup + marker are preserved; only the grant-row dual-control PREDICATE (the actual asymmetry) is unified to the canonical source.
files_changed: src/http/report-page-render.ts (import criticalGrantPredicate; add confirmed_by + dual-control + canonical assignment predicate to the grant query; export defaultCheckReadGrant as a testing seam)
ci/checks/db/report_page_render_ac6.test.ts (seed a CONFIRMED grant — previously omitted confirmed_by, encoding the hole)
resolver_unification_note: No 3rd bespoke resolver created. The dual-control/criticality classification now has ONE source (criticalGrantPredicate in grants-dao.ts), used by both getGrantsForSubject step 3 AND defaultCheckReadGrant. Confirmed the canonical resolver registry (actor-authority-deactivation-gate.sh AUTHORITY_RESOLVERS) is unchanged; defaultCheckReadGrant stays resolver C and still carries ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL (FF-0662-1 PASS on its 1 lookup).
mutation_proof: RED without fix / GREEN with fix — verified against real PG (:55432). With the three added grant-row predicates reverted, read-grant-dual-control.db.test.ts case (b) single-control critical grant and case (c) unconfirmed grant both FAIL (expected ok:false, received ok:true) — proving the pre-fix gate wrongly admitted them; case (a) stays green. With the fix restored all three pass.
